product.description:
Facial brushes are designed for various purposes — from deep cleansing and gentle exfoliation to stimulating the skin. Each type of brush serves a unique function, helping to maintain the health and freshness of the skin:

⸻

Fine Brush

• Usage: for treating small and delicate areas — around the nose and eye contour.

• Purpose:

• Thorough cleansing of hard-to-reach skin areas;

• Precise application of cleansing products;

• Suitable for sensitive and thin skin.

⸻

Round Brush

• Usage: for the entire face.

• Purpose:

• Deep cleansing of pores.

• Stimulation of blood circulation through circular motions.

• Gentle mechanical peeling.

• Preparation of the skin for subsequent treatments (serums, masks, etc.).

⸻

Large Brush

• Areas of use: neck, décolleté, and, if the skin is sufficiently delicate, also the face.

• Purpose:

• Quick and effective cleansing of large skin areas.

• Stimulation of lymphatic drainage and improvement of blood circulation.

• Additionally: may be used for body treatments depending on the type of brush.

⸻

General recommendations:

• Use brushes only on clean and slightly damp skin.

• Avoid use if there is irritation, inflammation, or severe active acne.

• Regularly disinfect brushes to prevent bacterial contamination and maintain hygiene.

product.name: Global Fashion Camouflage nail base, Hema free, 8 ml 13
product.category: Health - Beauty > Cosmetics & Fragrances > Make Up > Nails > Nail Colour > Top/Base Coats
product.description:
Why did we remove HEMA from the Global Fashion HEMA Free Base?

To prevent possible allergic reactions and create a product that is:

• much safer

• hypoallergenic

• suitable even for the most sensitive clients

• practically allergy-free

The HEMA Free Base is formulated with modern, non-irritating polymers that provide the same strength and excellent adhesion without the risks associated with HEMA.

Camouflage Nail Base – Flawless quality and safety in every application!

The Global Fashion Camouflage Rubber Base is the ideal choice for professionals who value high-quality performance, client comfort, and safety. Its innovative formula ensures superior adhesion and long-lasting wear while replacing potentially allergenic components with safer alternatives—without compromising effectiveness.

Thanks to its rubber-like texture, the base is easy to apply, self-levels perfectly, and allows effortless nail plate shaping. It’s ideal for thin and sensitive nails, providing flawless durability for up to 4 weeks without causing discomfort during curing.

Key Features:

  • Rubberized texture: Perfect for leveling and modeling the nail plate, ensures smooth, even application.
  • Excellent adhesion: Long-lasting wear for up to 4 weeks, ideal for thin or sensitive nails.
  • Optimized formula: Instead of HEMA, it uses a combination of HEMA Isobornyl Methacrylate and Di-HEMA Trimethylhexyl Dicarbamate, significantly reducing the risk of allergic reactions while providing even stronger adhesion to the nail plate.
  • Fast curing: Quickly hardens under UV or LED lamps, saving time.
  • Safety: Does not cause discomfort or irritation during curing.

Benefits:

  • Safety and comfort: Optimized formula minimizes allergy risks, ensuring safe and effective application.
  • Durability: Protects nails for up to 4 weeks without peeling or cracking.
  • Perfect for sensitive nails: Suitable for thin, brittle, or easily split nails.

Usage Instructions:

  1. Apply the base: After nail preparation, apply a thin layer of the Camouflage Rubber Base Coat.
  2. Leveling: Spread evenly across the nail for a smooth, even surface.
  3. Curing: Cure under a UV lamp for 2–3 minutes or under an LED lamp for 30–60 seconds.
  4. Apply color: After curing, apply your chosen gel or gel polish, and finish with a top coat for lasting shine and protection.

Sensitivity Test:

Although the formula is designed to minimize risks, it is recommended to perform a patch test, especially for clients with heightened sensitivity or allergy tendencies.

Perfect for nail professionals who value high quality, client safety, and long-lasting results. The Global Fashion Camouflage Rubber Base Coat is your reliable choice for strong, healthy nails with a flawless finish!

What does CC mean?

CC stands for Color Correcting. These products are intended to neutralize redness, pigmentation spots, and other skin tone imperfections, giving the skin an even, natural, and radiant appearance.

The term “Poreless” refers to a pore-free effect. Foundations with this effect visually reduce pores, making the skin smooth, velvety, and giving it a professionally cared-for matte or velvety finish.
